cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, ethereal stillness that evokes a sense of quiet awakening.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female) and Ensemble B (Mixed Choir).
cards.palette: A grand piano with a bright, resonant tone establishes the harmonic foundation in the intro and remains present throughout, anchoring the chord progressions even when obscured by the orchestra.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a delicate, wistful melancholy driven by solo strings, which gradually swells into a majestic and awe-inspiring climax as the full orchestra and choir unite.
cards.vocal: A mixed SATB choir (Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass).
cards.palette: A lush string section (violins, violas, cellos) serves as the harmonic and melodic core, present from the very beginning with a solo violin line that expands into full section swells, carrying through to the final fade.
